BEHIND THE CLASSIFIER

The same model.
A more comfortable workspace.

This workspace uses the classifier trained on your Zimbabwe news dataset. It reads the headline and article together, considers the first 1,000 words, and compares six categories.

Its predictions run directly in your browser. Your entered text is not sent to a prediction server, and recent stories disappear when you close or reload this tab.

READ THE RESULTS WITH CONTEXT

A helpful starting point.

Training labels came from publisher sections and have not been independently reviewed. An article may fit more than one category, and a model score is not a guarantee.

The evaluation uses an 80/20 split of the dataset. Similar stories and publisher styles can affect results. It does not establish accuracy on every new story.

Dataset sources include The Zimbabwean, Spiked, 263Chat, HealthTimes, TechnoMag, Open Parly and Zimbabwe Situation.
